نحتشم (form VIII)
# نَحْتَشِمُ (naḥtašimu) /naħ.ta.ʃi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# نَحْتَشِمَ (naḥtašima) /naħ.ta.ʃi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
# نَحْتَشِمْ (naḥtašim) /naħ.ta.ʃim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَشَمَ (iḥtašama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
